description: February 7 birthday meaning: Aquarius decan 2, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a February 7 birthday falls in Aquarius, in the second decan, with Uranus as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aquarius is fixed and air.

sections.heading: February 7 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: The quiet thinker of the Aquarius calendar may well be born on February 7. The Sun is near eighteen degrees of the sign, Mercury colours the decan and the birthday number is 7, the seeker. Read together, this points to an analytical, private mind that enjoys abstract puzzles and keeps its most original ideas close.

On February 7 the Sun usually sits at about 18° Aquarius, in the second decan, where Mercury is the sub-ruler alongside Uranus. Between 10 and 19 degrees of Aquarius the sub-ruler is Mercury, the ruler of Gemini. Birthdays from around January 30 to February 8 tend to bring a quick, communicative intelligence to the sign's idealism. Natives are often seen as witty, curious and well networked, the kind of person who knows someone in every group and enjoys connecting them. Writing, teaching and technical problem-solving are commonly associated with this decan. Mercury can make the mind race ahead of the body and the heart. Slowing down long enough to listen as well as explain usually deepens their many connections.

sections.heading: February 7 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 7th, you have a birthday number of 7 in its plain form. Numerology treats the birth day as a secondary influence, often visible in how a person thinks rather than what they do. The 7 has long been regarded as the seeker's number, linked with analysis, solitude and questions that do not have quick answers. Natives of the 7th are frequently described as observant, private and happiest when they can go deep into a subject. Time alone tends to recharge them, and trust in their intuition often grows as they learn when to stop overthinking.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one February 7 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on February 7: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 7 is the 38th day of the year. By February 19, 12 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Pisces.

For the Chinese zodiac, February 7 sits inside the Lunar New Year window: in 72 of the 121 years from 1924 to 2044 the new year has already begun by this date, so check the year before choosing an animal. Well-known people born on February 7 include Charles Dickens (1812), Alfred Adler (1870) and Tawakkol Karman (1979).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 7?
faq.answer: February 7 is Aquarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Aquarius, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 7?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 7 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 7th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 7?
faq.answer: February 7 is a date where the Chinese animal genuinely depends on the year. Lunar New Year had arrived by this date in 72 of 121 years between 1924 and 2044; in the others the birth belongs to the previous animal.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 7?
faq.answer: February 7 is also the birthday of Charles Dickens (1812), Alfred Adler (1870) and Tawakkol Karman (1979). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
